layers.name: usvi_fema_panels_wms
layers.attribution: FEMA, as the administrator of the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP), has created Advisory Base Flood Elevations (ABFEs) for the territory of US Virgin Islands. The ABFE information and related layers depicted on this web service for US Virgin Islands can serve as a guide to understanding current flood hazard conditions and higher elevations that communities should build to in order to reduce impacts of similar events in the future. All elevations included on the map are referenced to the Virgin Islands Vertical Datum 2009 (VIVD09).
